svg.title: Fig 2 — Station overview (Med Tower)
svg.text: One locked tower holds every drug: a turret of 8 vial columns turns over a fixed floor with a flush dosing disc at the front; the Orange Pi 5 host sits behind and talks to the micro:bit over one USB cable.

g.text: Conceptual — not to scale; geometry defined in team CAD
UI · dose logic · PIN + badge auth
MED TOWER — the whole housing is the locked safe
on the housing wall · not weighed
col 0 · top vial seen from above
one column wide → only that column
5 layers of vials on their sides
flush with the floor; rests with its pocket
outside the turret, over the exit hole
pocket under the front column takes
its bottom vial, then swings back
flap is lifted by the medic;
it is not in the vial path
S1 + gears, S2: all on ONE
fixed end on the housing floor

svg.text: Smart Med Station · Hardware design v2.1 · 2026-10-07
